title: One defect found by two roles
description: Two isolated roles report the same unchecked nil response and the gate preserves one finding with both sources.

candidates.title: Successful nil response panics

evidence.execution_path: Client.Fetch returns nil, nil; Value dereferences response
evidence.violated_invariant: A successful dependency response must be non-nil before dereference
evidence.falsifier_checked: The Client contract and function contain no non-nil guarantee or guard

candidates.impact: A permitted dependency result crashes the request path.
candidates.recommendation: Reject a nil response before dereferencing it.
